Generated

How many tests cover each spec. Every test is the same width on this page, so two specs with the same number of tests have bars of exactly the same length. The first column is the whole spec; the tier columns show where its tests live.

Tests per spec, on one ruler

Faint lines in the first column mark every 5 tests. A dash means a tier has no tests for that spec, and a dashed bar means the spec has no tests at all. Hover a segment to see the test names, and click it to select its tests for a change request.

Click a colour to change it, or a name to hide its tests. Changes stay in this browser only.

Selected tests

Untick any test to leave out, choose the change, then copy the request and paste it to Claude in chat.

    Tags live in the test files as a comment above each test, for example // spec: FR-3; cat: logic. Rebuild this page with node visualtdd.mjs. A test that cites two specs appears in both rows, so row totals can add up to more than the test count.
